thread:
elaine_support: @matt_oncall Acme integration started getting fncall validation errors ~10:07 UTC. They say they didn't change anything on their side. Sample payload + error below.

matt_oncall: Can you paste the raw payload from the logs and the runtime error?

elaine_support: From our ingress logs (redacted):

```json
{
  "customer_id": "acme-123",
  "order": {
    "id": "ord-987",
    "items": null
  }
}
```

They call our submitOrder function and get: 

``
Error: FunctionValidationError: field 'order.items' expected array but got null
    at runtime/validate.js:43
```

jen_sdk: I reproduced locally with py-sdk v0.14.2. If a client-layer plugin drops empty arrays or an SDK transform coerces [] -> null (some serializers/plugins do this), our structured-json mode validation blows up.

dave_infra: Alert: increased fncall validation 5xx rate and latency in prod us-west-2 starting 10:05 UTC. Rolling fallback engaged for two high-traffic customers.

jen_sdk: Quick repro steps I used:
1) node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify({order:{id:'x',items:null}}))"
2) call POST /v1/call with json_mode on and function schema requires items: array
3) runtime rejects with FunctionValidationError

Workaround: ensure callers send items: [] explicitly. Long-term: we should be tolerant on server side to accept null->[] for array-typed args, or have SDK avoid turning [] -> null.

elaine_support: Acme can't push a client change today. They asked if we can tolerate this server-side because it's blocking shipping.

matt_oncall: SRE request: can infra add a temporary tolerant deserialiser that maps null -> [] for schema-declared arrays? Put behind a feature flag and metric so we can revert. Also need an emergency rollout plan if it causes regressions.

dave_infra: We can add a small shim in the runtime request deserialiser. It'll: 1) consult function schema, 2) coerce null to [] for array-typed fields, 3) increment metric fncall_schema_coercion. I'll open a hotfix ticket and run canary in prod.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1297 - fncall validation spike (link: https://incident.internal/INC-2026-1297)

jen_sdk: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/892 - fixes serialization edge-case in node/python SDKs and adds e2e test for json_mode function calls. If infra adds the shim, we'll still release SDK patch next day but infra shim buys time.

matt_oncall: Plan agreed: (1) infra shim + canary (dave) within 2 hours, (2) SDK hotfix release (jen) next-day, (3) support note to customer asking to set items: [] when possible (elaine).

elaine_support: I informed Acme and gave ETA for hotfix. They provided additional logs showing a client plugin that collapses empty arrays -> null. Asked for a temporary server-side fix.

jen_sdk: I'll cut 0.14.3 hotfix after CI passes and add regression tests to prevent future serialiser regressions.

dave_infra: Hotfix ticket opened: INFRA-4621. Will implement shim behind feature flag and canary to 10% first. Will also add fncall_schema_coercion and fncall_validation_fail metrics.

matt_oncall: After shim is live and canary looks good, flip to 100% and update incident. Also add a unit test in runtime/validate that fails on null-in-array to prevent regressions (i.e., test should assert we accept null->[] only when shim enabled).

elaine_support: Will close loop with Acme and confirm unblocked. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
